title: Optimal Mean-Reversion Bands — OU Double Stopping (Leung & Li)
holding_period: days to weeks; determined by the fitted mean-reversion speed
signal_frequency: daily; entry and exit are threshold crossings
data_requirements: daily price history for both legs of the spread
sufficient sample to estimate the OU mean-reversion speed - the binding constraint
transaction cost estimate per round trip

sources.citation: Leung, T., & Li, X. Optimal Mean Reversion Trading with Transaction Costs and Stop-Loss Exit. arXiv:1411.5062v3 (14 May 2015); published in International Journal of Theoretical and Applied Finance 18(3), 2015.
Leung, T., & Li, X. (2016). Optimal Mean Reversion Trading: Mathematical Analysis and Practical Applications. World Scientific.
Elliott, R. J., van der Hoek, J., & Malcolm, W. P. (2005). Pairs trading. Quantitative Finance, 5(3), 271-276.
